title: lodash.isequal is deprecated
summary: npm recommends replacing lodash.isequal with node:util.isDeepStrictEqual.

constraints: Confirm compatibility for prototypes, boxed primitives, Maps, Sets, typed arrays, symbols, circular references, and cross-realm values.

steps.title: Compare equality semantics
steps.instructions: Identify value types used at each call site and confirm node:util.isDeepStrictEqual has acceptable semantics.

steps.title: Use Node deep strict equality
steps.instructions: Replace lodash.isequal imports and calls with node:util.isDeepStrictEqual, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run deep-equality edge cases and repository tests.
